points: 2029 forecast raised 2.7x from $295bn to about $800bn; roughly 42% annual growth from $154bn in 2025
GPU-accelerated servers are the largest category, followed by switching, racks, power and cooling
read: IDC press release at the OCP Global Summit, 13 October 2026
take: IDC nearly triples its forecast for OCP-based servers, racks and cooling, a sign open hardware designs now shape AI infrastructure buying beyond hyperscalers.
title: IDC: open-design data centre gear to reach $800bn a year by 2029
